text:
irene_ops: Heads-up: starting v2 canary warmup on eu-west1 in ~10m. Deploybot scheduled 2024-04-04T10:10Z. Expect p95 bump ~20ms -> ~80ms for a few minutes. No client pins yet; draft release notes live at /docs/releases/2024-04-v2-warmup (edit-only).
deploybot: Canary warmup queued. Preflight checks: model-compat, header-sanitizer, client-timeout-override. ETA ~4m. preflight_status=warning/0/errors/0.
sam_sre: We saw a mobile client timeout regression at ~70ms in last internal test. Can we add a 2s client-backoff for mobile routes for the warmup? @irene_ops
alice_dev: I pushed a gateway shim that lowercases Version header for canary traffic. Image: v2-canary-20240404. No model/schema change, just header normalization.
ben_release: Release notes draft: call out header case normalization + recommend SDK bump. Adding rollback steps. Can someone proofread the customer-facing blurb before I publish?
irene_ops: @sam_sre adding route-level timeout override: /mobile/* => 3s for warmup. Will push routing change when deploybot confirms preflight.
sam_sre: Also request metric: gateway.header_case_mismatch.count so we'll alert if normalization causes client errors.
deploybot: Preflight result: OK with one warning. Warning: client-probe failures=3 (rate limited). Suggestion: slowstart 3m instead of 1m to reduce probe pressure. To apply: `deploybot slowstart 3m`.
irene_ops: Agree. Applying slowstart=3m now.
alice_dev: operator snippet if useful:
```shell
# apply slowstart for canary
deploybot set --canary v2-canary-20240404 --slowstart 3m
```
ben_release: Added customer advice: "If you see increased 504s, revert header normalization or pin to v1 via header `X-API-Version: 1`." Added that to rollback section.
sam_sre: What's our rollback window? 30m default. I'd prefer 45m given mobile uncertainty.
irene_ops: Extending rollback window to 45m and updating checklist. Alert thresholds: if error rate >5% for 5m -> auto rollback. I'll ping #eng-oncall if threshold trips.
ben_release: lgtm. I'll finish notes and email changelog after 1h if warmup stays stable :thumbsup:
